text: Láá Láá Bwamu is a member of the Gur branch of Niger-Congo languages. It is spoken in the west of Burkina Faso by about 69,200 people, particularly in Balé Province in the Boucle du Mouhoun Region, and in the Hauts-Bassins Region.
